title: PanNuke quantitative evaluation
protocol: Three split-specific training configurations (133, 233, 311) evaluated on two official PanNuke test folds (Fold 3, Fold 3, Fold 1); values are equal-weight means over the three configurations.

metrics.Fd: Detection F1, HoVer-Net pairing (Hungarian on centroids, radius 12 px); identical code for every row (directional_errors.py / analyze_official.py, same definitions)
metrics.Acc_type: Type accuracy over paired nuclei (HoVer-Net definition, same pairing)
metrics.mPQ: Multi-class PQ, official PanNuke organ-averaged definition (PanNuke-metrics c00014d), parity_score_nbe.py
metrics.bPQ: Binary PQ, official PanNuke organ-averaged definition, parity_score_nbe.py

rule: same column = same metric definition + same scorer; no composite quality–efficiency score
